source: NOT in HOST_FACTS.md: measured 2026-10-28 with `syns history --file app/outside.md --json`, CLI 0.3.25, in a kit/scratch.py repository since deleted (Syns B-0087): a root file `syns mv`'d into app/, edited at the root before and in app/ after. Each row names the file's own path at that version (`path`) and, on the version that moved it, where it stood before (`movedFrom`); `syns history --json` names that version's filesChanged as [movedFrom, path].
